items.name: Finnish FMC Series VIII 2025
items.information:
**This is an FMC only competition. No speedsolving events will be held.**
Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor.

**Tämän kisan ainoa laji on vähiten siirtoja. Speedsolving -lajeja ei pidetä.**
Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua.
Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija.

items.name: CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2025
items.information:
This competition is supported by **[CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/)** as the Southeast [Regional Championship](https://cubingusa.org/regional) for 2025. Residents of **Alabama**, **Florida**, **Georgia**, **North Carolina**, **South Carolina**, and **Tennessee** are eligible for the title of Southeast Champion.

items.name: Flushing Glow at Night 2025
items.information:
Please note that this competition takes place on a **Friday evening.** See the schedule for the exact times/details.

This competition is sponsored by the Glow Cultural Center, which provides cultural, wellness, and youth development programs and serves as a hub for community activity. Glow aims to serve the multi-cultural population of the community, including but not limited to the under-served new immigrant, low-income households residing in Flushing and nearby communities. All proceeds from this competition will go to the Glow Cultural Center. Please see the Sponsor/Fundraiser tab for more details.
